topic: How does defocused feed array placement optimize coverage versus scan loss in DBF architectures?
consensus_response: Defocused feed array placement optimizes coverage by reducing taper loss and improving illumination uniformity, albeit at the cost of increased spillover and scan losses. This trade-off enhances robustness against feed failures, with a marginal increase in total loss, balancing performance degradation and coverage uniformity.
reference_context: Defocused reflector concepts mitigate feed element failures, optimizing coverage and scan loss through balanced energy distribution.
